title: epipactis viridiflora subsp. pollinensis
intro: Epipactis viridiflora subsp. pollinensis, commonly known as the Green Helleborine, is a rare and endangered orchid native to Europe. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis viridiflora subsp. pollinensis include antiviral, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, as well as anti-cancer and anti-aging effects. Its bioactive constituents include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in treating various diseases.
